method: Reviewed conservative core-layout families; fixed assignment, no question-level randomization or model-score selection

industry_evidence: Inferred from README unit-conversion products and sector rules, drug/lot files, and sampled product rows. DanhSachQuyDoi rows confirm biz_102/103 grocery (Coca Cola) and biz_104 coffee (croissant/tiramisu); supplied question product names corroborate this. biz_110 has invoice-only data and no reliable explicit sector: kept unknown.
limitations: Families are a reviewed conservative layout grouping, not a guarantee of no shared vocabulary, product names, question templates or semantic table roles across partitions.
Holdout isolates the relational-CSV family, has coffee/restaurant only, and contains no boolean or unanswerable labels. Report these limitations; do not use this score alone as a global estimate.
Only one SQLite and one mixed-source business exist; neither is in train. SQLite is used for calibration, mixed-source for development. Format coverage cannot be balanced across all four sets.
Answer types are used only for aggregate split diagnostics; answer/alias values are never used to select membership. No model predictions or public-test inputs are used.
Calibration has only three businesses and few rare-type labels; thresholds may be noisy. Use additional grouped validation within train if needed, without tuning on holdout.
